## Mission

The DS Lab is DIAD's transversal team. It builds the data foundations that the three business teams, and other WOAH departments, rely on: data products on Microsoft Fabric, data management and analytics pipelines, process automation and ad-hoc analyses. It also spearheads AI adoption across the Organisation.

## What we build

::: {.features}
::: {.feature}
#### Master datasets
Countries, diseases and disease status (glossary forthcoming): one reference version for all of WOAH, citable through DOIs.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### APIs for programs
Master datasets made available to programs through an API, with no human in the loop.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### Data for AI (MCP)
A project to make WOAH data directly queryable by AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### AI adoption
Tools such as a translation app and a standards query app, and an MSc-AI internship programme scaling AI into daily use.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### One platform
Microsoft Fabric Lakehouses as the single storage platform, with ownership kept by technical departments.
:::
::: {.feature}
#### Datathon
The [WOAH Datathon 2026](https://dia-dpt-woah.github.io/WOAH-Datathon/) is an international datathon on animal health data science: surveillance, risk, trade and impact assessment.
:::
:::

::: {.band .green}
### Access WOAH data

| Who | Channel | What |
|---|---|---|
| Programs | API, no human in the loop | Master datasets: in progress |
| AI assistants | MCP (project) | WOAH data queryable by large language models |
:::
